purpose: Each patient's balance: what was invoiced, what was collected and what they owe.
tips: Choose the filters and tap «Generate»: the report isn't calculated on its own.

reports.cuentas-corrientes.section.filte.label: Filters
reports.cuentas-corrientes.section.filte.description: Currency and status (owing, up to date, in credit).

reports.cuentas-corrientes.section.kpi.label: Indicators
reports.cuentas-corrientes.section.kpi.description: Total invoiced, total collected, net balance and how many patients owe.

reports.cuentas-corrientes.section.resul.label: Results
reports.cuentas-corrientes.section.resul.description: One row per patient with their balance; tap the name to go to their record.
